tested_summary: Bitemporal hemianopia from optic chiasm compression

PitNET gross morphology, monomorphic H&E vs. normal inset, reticulin stain (hyperplasia vs. neoplasia), WHO 2022 IHC transcription factors (PIT1/TPIT/SF1), and micro (<1 cm) vs. macroadenoma (≥1 cm) MRI
Adamantinomatous (CTNNB1, wet keratin, machinery oil) vs. papillary (BRAF p.V600E) craniopharyngioma A/B histology + pediatric MRI
Prolactinoma (>200 ng/mL, first-line dopamine agonist), acromegaly (IGF-1/OGTT, transsphenoidal resection), and gigantism
Pituitary apoplexy mass effects & emergent IV glucocorticoid + decompression

Acquired hypopituitarism: lymphocytic hypophysitis (histology + MRI), Sheehan syndrome, empty sella MRI, >75% loss order & proportionate short stature
Posterior pituitary & hypothalamus: central vs. nephrogenic DI, water deprivation/desmopressin test, SIAD/vaptan V2 mechanism, hypothalamic nuclei localization
